'''Maglin Madwen''' is the [[innkeeper]] at the [[The Nine Rings (inn)]] in [[Tremonsien]]. She was originally from [[Lugard]]. She was married to [[Barin Madwen]] and inherited the inn after being married for 23 years.

==Appearance==
Maglin Madwen is lean with a long nose and graying hair. 

==Activities==
Maglin welcomes [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Hurin]], [[Selene]] and [[Loial]] to the Nine Rings when the group is traveling to Cairhien with the [[Horn of Valere]]. She gives Rand advice on dealing with Selene since they are obviously at odds.{{ref/book|2|21}}
